summary: The registry-switch runbook walks the plan's eleven steps in order, each with the operator's command and what to see, fixes forward, and ends with the dead-after list. Its claims about the guard render, the flip and autoSync edits, the equivalence tool, the webhook proof and step 11's greps all held on targeted runs. One advisory: some status reads run straight after an asynchronous sync or refresh.

findings.summary: Steps 1d, 4, 9 and 10 read status straight after an asynchronous argosync/refresh with no wait instruction; step 1d's no-diff proof can pass on a pre-sync read
